title: Sandpiper Point Rising
author: Sebastian Marchetti
blurb: Orsen Thornbury, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
